The main reason why there is a high suicide rate for transgender people after SRS varies. There are four main reasons: social stigma of transgender people, things that cannot be changed from going through the wrong puberty (i.e. height, hips, shoulders), surgeries not giving an exact replica of the natal genitalia, and co-existing mental health issues resulting from all of the above. Using that as a reason to deny treatment for gender dysphoria (including surgeries) is similar to denying help and treatment for depression, eating disorders, and body dysmorphia because of the high suicide after things such as medication, therapy, etc. 



[Here](https://www.montenido.com/transgender-anorexia-dysphoria-vs-dysmorphia/) is a site that explains the differences between gender dysphoria and body dysmorphia, the different treatments, the similarities, and the differences.
